svg.font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Which branding job, and which of the twelve books covers it
svg.desc: Personal branding maps to Personal Branding For Dummies and The Brand You50. Product branding maps to The 22 Immutable Laws of Branding and Building Strong Brands. Service branding maps to Building a StoryBrand 2.0. Corporate branding maps to Designing Brand Identity. Co-branding maps to Building Strong Brands. Place branding and no-brand branding have no dedicated book on the list.
svg.text: BRANDING IS AT LEAST SEVEN DIFFERENT JOBS
THE JOB YOU ARE PAID TO DO
WHICH OF THE TWELVE TO READ
Personal Branding For Dummies · The Brand You50
The 22 Immutable Laws of Branding · Building Strong Brands
Designing Brand Identity, the only one written for a whole team
Building Strong Brands — co-branding is a trade in borrowed equity
No book here.Take The Brand Gap as the framework instead.
No book here.It is a decision, not the absence of branding.
No book on this list covers more than two of these well. Read the one for the job in front of you.
